title: A two-week plan
summary: Tick off a study plan that goes from the execution model to mock interviews.
items: Days 1–2: the *GPU execution model* track here, then the GPU gym warm-up track (vector add, ReLU, SAXPY) in CUDA.
Days 3–4: *Memory access patterns* here, then `transpose` and `reduction` in the GPU gym.
Day 5: *Rooflines and estimates*. Write the interview GPU's numbers from memory on a blank page.
Days 6–7: *Kernel algorithms on a CPU*, then `prefix_sum`, `row_softmax` and `layer_norm` in the GPU gym.
Day 8: `matmul` in the GPU gym; read Simon Boehm's matmul article and try two of its steps.
Day 12: `attention` or `causal_attention` in the GPU gym, in Triton or CUDA.
Days 13–14: *Mock interview questions*, timed, out loud. Redo every exercise you got wrong.
